gags.gag: buffering spinner on the map pin
gags.description: The 'You are here' mural's pin gets a loading spinner in its head, a wait cursor beside it, and a route panel below reads 'buffering route...' with a progress bar that creeps to 99% and sticks; the panel prints STILL NOT LOST. word by word.

gags.gag: spinner keeps spinning, line printed in the route panel
gags.description: Spinner and 99% bar stay stuck while JUST CREATIVELY DELAYED. pops into the route panel on its sung words (sung word tangerine).

gags.gag: taco lands on the pin, end card
gags.description: A taco drops onto the pin head on 'snacks' (squash, small confetti burst), the spinner vanishes, the bar jumps to 100% 'route loaded', then the end card resolves: STILL NOT LOST. (top) / JUST CREATIVELY DELAYED. / WITH SNACKS. + taco (mustard), camera pushes gently into the pin and holds still for the ring-out.

debrisIds: ledger (no manual debris); DebrisLayer at the same pose as Camera every frame (MURAL_POSE, then a push about the pin to scale 0.38)
localProps: RoutePanel (buffering panel, progress bar stuck at 99%)
EndCard (end-card phrase sticker, renders without lyrics)
promotionCandidates: EndCard: a LyricCard-styled sticker that ignores showLyrics, for in-picture type
